DORSET DIVISION - SIX PAGE WORKING WEBSITE PREVIEW
Open index.html in a browser. Upload all files and assets/ folder together to static hosting.

INCLUDED:
Home, About, Approach, Work, Reviews, Contact
Responsive CSS; mobile navigation; scroll reveals; reviews carousel; How I Work carousel; portfolio filters; reduced-motion support; booking/email/tel links.
Real supplied photograph of Marnie is used. Visual treatments are derived from supplied design references, but this is a coded interpretation, not a pixel-perfect reconstruction.

BEFORE PUBLISHING:
1. Verify all portfolio descriptions and replace illustrative assets for OSIER and Little Leaps with actual client work.
2. Add exact PeoplePerHour profile URL to reviews.html (currently links to PPH homepage). Replace summary carousel cards with verbatim, permission-cleared reviews if desired.
3. Connect a hosted contact form service if direct submission is needed. Current form safely prepares an email using mailto: and requires an installed email client.
4. Confirm consent for using portfolio/client assets and final text.
5. Review all pages on mobile and desktop before going live.
